draft.subject: Photographing Tidewater on March 10 and March 24
draft.body:
Hi Rhea,

My name is Dan and I'm a professional arts photographer here in NYC. I'm writing about Tidewater at The Example Stage, and specifically your performances on March 10 and March 24. I work in an unobtrusive documentary style, no flash and no interruption, so the audience stays with the play rather than noticing a photographer. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for close to ten years, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. If you don't already have someone covering those two nights, I'd be glad to talk through your photography plans. I look forward to hearing from you.
